original: We made it to Vamdemon's castle,\nbut it's gonna be hard to get us\nall in there.
It doesn't seem like we'll be able\nto sneak in without being noticed.
So then what are we gonna do?
Leave it to me!
Agumon...
The castle's full of Digimon, so I\ncan sneak in if I go by myself!
If we can infiltrate Vamdemon's\narmy, it may work out!
I'm worried about Agumon going in\nthere alone, so I'm going in, too!
Are they gonna be okay?
Leave it to me! I may not look the\npart, but I'm pretty confident in\nmy acting skills!
Got it! If you find someplace you\nthink we can sneak in through,\ncome back here!
Okay! Wait for us!
Are they gonna be okay?
Recruiting Soldiers
I don't know how many they must\nhave gathered by now, but it's\nbetter to be safe than sorry.
*sigh* They're a bunch of useless\ngrunts.
No need to worry! I'll train 'em\nreal hard!
I'm counting on you. Considering\nyour experience, you're the only\nsuitable teacher around here.
Indeed!
All right then, I'll leave them in\nyour hands!
Hey, is it true you're recruiting\nsoldiers?
Can we join?
Hmm. They might be better than\nthis lot. Okay, get over here!
Okay, fresh meat, first you'll be\nrunning 100 laps! After that, 500\nbunny hops!
What are we gonna do....
At this rate, it desn't look like\nwe'll have a chance to get the\nothers inside.
We have to do something about\nNanimon.
Hey, I was in a unit with him\nonce.
...Tell us more.
He kept getting drunk off alcohol,\nso he was completely useless in\nreal combat.
So he's a heavy drinker.
That might be what we need!
Lord Vamdemon, I am pleased to\nreport that we have gathered a\nmultitude of soldiers.
Are they of use to us?
P-Probably...
Ahahaha...
Can you even call them soldiers?\nAre you trying to make a B-team or\nsomething?
Ugh, if you keep talking like\nthat, I'm gonna...
What? You wanna go?
Stop. Anyway, Tailmon, did you\nfind anyone useful?
Yes, as instructed. I've traveled\naround and scouted a number of\nrespected veterans.
I look forward to meeting them.
Yes, sir!
Hahaha!
Are they still in there?!
I'm getting impatient.
Hm?
Sorry to keep you waiting!
Palmon! You made it!
You did it!
Just a second! Poison Ivy!
Grab onto the vines and get in\nhere!
Okay! ...gh!
Is this gonna hold?
It'll be fine, hurry! We're in a\nbit of a tight situation here!
O-okay ...ughh!
Whew, we got everyone in. I'm\ntired...
So this is how we do it!\nAll right, let's head in!
Yeah!
This is a huge castle...
Yeah, and there might be some\ntraps around here. Be careful.
All right, I'll go check it out!
You go first, Yamato.
All right, I'll go check it out!
No, I'll go!
Yamato...
Taichi, if you take the lead,\nwe'll all get caught in some trap.
Ahahaha!
Don't you start laughing too,\nAgumon!
You go first, Yamato.
What?! Yamato, are you okay with\nthis?
Yamato will do a better job of\nbeing careful around Vamdemon's\nminions.
We're all good and bad at\ndifferent things. Taichi knows his\nstrengths and weaknesses, right?
See, even I can be more of an\nadult sometimes!
Hm? What's this?
Is it safe to approach?
It seems like it transfers you to\nanother space, like a warp point.
I don't think it's dangerous per\nse, but if we use it carelessly,\nwe may get lost.
I guess we'll have to be careful.
There ought to be a map.
I guess we'll have to be careful\nabout going forward.
Yes, we need to remember the\nlocations of the warp entry and\nexit points.
There ought to be a map with\nproper directions.
No, it's probably a puzzle to keep\nout thieves, so we'll have to\nmemorize all of the directions.
So we've got no choice but to keep\ngoing, right?
It seems so.
This place is considerably\nstrange. The space here is\ndistorted and twisted.
This world's weird enough, it\ndoesn't need this on top of it!
There's something special about \nthis place. Is it because \nVamdemon's power is stronger here?
Don't say things like that. It's\ntoo scary!
Anyway, let's keep going!
The time is nigh! We shall depart!
Yes!
Yes!
Our objective is the eighth Chosen\nChild! Their corpse will be the\nbase of my grand ambitions!
Everything will be consumed by the\npower of darkness!
Yeah!
Tlon, Uqbar, Orbis Tertius!
Now, we depart!
Waaaaaaaaaaait! We won't let you\ndo that!
So you're finally here...But\nyou're too late. Observe this\nhistoric moment!
Don't mess with us!
Unfortunately, I don't have the\ntime to deal with you.\nPicoDevimon!
Yes, sir!
Wanna fight us again?
This won't be like last time!\nNanimon, I'll leave 'em to you!
Got it! You losers are in the way!\nGet out, you rascals!
I surrender, I surrender!
Nanimon! You can't do that!
They say retreating is winning in\nits own way! Now, excuse meeeeeee!
So, what are you gonna do?
S-so sneaky! There's so many of\nyou here...
Come on, we don't have the time\nfor this. Let's take him down!
I-I could say the same for you,\nI'll take *you* down!
Aaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!
Hurry! The gate's closing!
We don't have time to play around!\nLet's go!
Ugh, what an eyesore!
Another little one. Shoo! Shoo!\nScram! You don't want to get hurt,\ndo you?
Don't make fun of me! Just watch!
Cat Kick! Cat Punch!
Aaaaaaaah!
She's stronger than she looks...
It's our turn now!
Let's go!
I'll have to stop you! Devidramon,\ngo!
Grooooooooooooah!
We did it!
Hurry! Dive into the gate!
Okay, here I go!
I can't let you do that!
Aaaaaaaah!
Gyaaaaaaaah!
Noooooooooooo!
Bye-bye~!
Aaaaah!
No way!
And we were so close...
No! At this rate, the eighth child\nis gonna...
It's too much for us. Everyone,\nrun!
Come on! Taichi...
Taichi...
I see. That's a shame.
It's not just a "shame"! At this\npoint, the eighth child is doomed!
Not just that, all those Digimon\nare gonna rampage throughout Japan \nand cause all sorts of chaos!
Hm...
Isn't there another way to open\nthe gate?
There's another way, but...
Really?!
Hm, but it's not easy to explain.
We don't have time to waste!
All right, then. Why don't you\ncome to my place?
Your place?
Take a look behind you.
Ah! Over there!
If you follow that light, you'll\narrive at my place.
Got it!
Then I'll be waiting for you.
